title: Grateful Dead Live at The Palladium on 1977-05-01
source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM-33Ps>Sony TC-152 from first row loge

ai_review.summary: Muddy audience recording where the band sounds distant; a few listeners find it usable after EQ tweaks, but overall clarity is poor.
ai_review.review: The three reviews focus almost entirely on the audio quality. Two reviewers describe the tape as muddy and less clear than other audience recordings, while one enthusiast notes that with a low‑frequency roll‑off the sound can be brought forward and enjoys the characteristic Jerry Moore ambience. No comments were made about the musical performance or specific songs.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~3.3 stars; most feedback highlights poor clarity, but one reviewer rates it highly after EQ adjustment, leading to a mixed overall assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as muddy and distant with heavy audience presence; band sounds farther away than on comparable recordings. One reviewer suggests low‑frequency roll‑off can improve perceived proximity.
